title: ECG & cardiology
seo_description: ECG and cardiology reporting for clinics and labs: templates for ECG, 2D echo, and treadmill studies, digital signature, and one record with lab and imaging results.

fields.hero_title: ECG, 2D echo, and treadmill reports in the same patient case
fields.hero_lead: Cardiology studies are reported from templates in the same system as lab tests and imaging, so a patient has one record, one bill, and one place to find every report.
fields.features:
Templates for ECG, 2D echo, and treadmill studies
Drafts saved automatically
Structured findings and impression
Digital signature, then send
One record and one bill with lab and imaging
Every report traceable to the signing doctor

steps.title: Register once
steps.text: The study is added to the patient case with any lab tests or scans.

steps.title: Report from a template
steps.text: Complete the findings for the study type; the draft saves as you go.

steps.title: Sign and deliver
steps.text: The signed report reaches the patient and the referring doctor right away.

fields.cta_title: See cardiology reporting with your own setup
fields.cta_text: Bring your test menu and price list. We will show you a patient case from registration to signed report, configured the way your team works.
